episode_days.evidence: 4-8 week design target; fixture uses 5 weeks

settlement_tail_days.evidence: settlement only (no orders, aging or holding) so terminal value counts settled positions

case_definition.evidence: most frequent eggplant package in USDA AMS terminal quotes (data/clean/usda_ams/terminal_quotes.parquet)

customer_base_cases.evidence: public average daily cases; scale not recoverable from normalized FreshRetailNet sales

customer_weekday_grocer.evidence: FreshRetailNet train weekday multipliers re-indexed Mon=0, normalized to mean 1 (retail-to-wholesale transfer assumed)

customer_weekday_restaurant_caterer.evidence: no restaurant/caterer ordering data in any source

order_log_sigma.evidence: below FreshRetailNet median uncensored daily CV 0.485 (which also contains weekday variation)

goodwill_response.evidence: action-dependent response; per-customer sensitivity is a generated latent; sensitivity analysis required

normal_price_c.evidence: USDA eggplant 1 1/9 bu Jan 2024 cross-section median mid $25.0 (data/calibration/usda_eggplant.json)

glut_depth_support.evidence: glut levels $11.81-$17.62, inside USDA report-date medians q10-q90 $11.0-$24.15 (nominal, 1999-2024)

price_dynamics.evidence: no keyless daily series; gluts ramp over ~3 days and last ~12 days on average

markup.evidence: exogenous same-day list = markup x terminal reference (sell prices are not an agent decision)

vendor_spread.evidence: grower discount / terminal premium relative to reference; V1 gross margin ~18% at stable prices

v1_schedule_pallets.evidence: needs operator validation: case packs, delivery schedule

v2_availability_and_age.evidence: same-day terminal supply is limited and of varied age

vendor_terms_days.evidence: V1 10 days mirrors the PACA default prompt-payment window (applicability assumed); V2 cash on purchase

decay.evidence: Weibull survival by age; V1 latent scale; per-lot frailty; no lot-aging data in any source. A lot received at age 3 keeps ~68% (poor) vs ~94% (good) of cases to age 6 (before lot frailty)

v1_receipt_age.evidence: distant grower; needs operator validation. With age 1 at receipt, vendor quality barely changed any decision (all 40 v0.3 forks were null controls)

quality_discount_reference.evidence: USDA same-date lower-quality/standard price ratio (not yet used; seed-4 inspection/claims)

terminal_nrv.evidence: unsold stock at episode end valued at final V1 offer x prior-mixture survival over 3 days

identities.cash: cash_close == cash_open + collected - paid - holding - disposal - interest
identities.accrual_vs_balance_sheet: equity_close - equity_open == net_income, equity = cash + AR + inventory at cost - AP; net_income = revenue - COGS - spoilage at cost - holding - disposal - interest

realized-path values are a diagnostic under the heuristic continuation, not an upper bound
